note: tapFrac = screen fraction from the TOP-LEFT. Derived from the rects this codegen actually writes, with the template's own conversion: the CanvasScaler is Expand @1242x2688, so on the 1080x2400 capture device the canvas resolves to 1242x2760 and SafeArea/AspecterSA (FitInParent 1242/2688) letterboxes the panel by 36 units top and bottom. tapFracX = panelX / 1242, tapFracY = (36 + (2688 - panelY)) / 2760 with panelY measured from the BOTTOM. Denominator 2760, NOT 2688.
